frames.heading: Nox
frames.body: Your rhythm... it's undeniable. Perhaps the Grand Composer's vision isn't the only path to harmony.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We all have our own unique beats to contribute to the universe. Now, let's replace another amp and face the next challenge.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Nox, Keep rocking with us, and the universe will never fall silent!

frames.heading: Nox
frames.body: Go forth, my friends. Solstice awaits you on the next platform. May your music bring light to the darkness.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: This place... it's so different from the others. It's like walking into a sun.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: That must be Solstice’s influence. Let's find her and bring the groove to this platform.

frames.heading: Solstice
frames.body: I am Solstice, the radiant guardian of this platform. Why do you intrude upon my domain?

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Solstice, we’re here to free the universe from the Grand Composer’s control. Crescendo and Nox have joined us. Now it's your turn to see the light of our cause!

frames.heading: Solstice
frames.body: Joined you? Their convictions must have been weak to falter so easily. The Grand Composer’s harmony is absolute!!!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Solstice, true harmony embraces every voice, every rhythm.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Your light is strong, but it's gotta blend with the universe's beat, not overshadow it!

frames.heading: Solstice
frames.body: Prove to me that your light can shine as brightly as mine.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We’re ready, Solstice. Let’s show her the power of our groove, Mojo!
